name: Pro Web Terminal
description: Multi-tab, split-pane xterm.js console with fit-on-resize, scrollback search, fuzzy command-history palette, session recording with replay timeline and asciicast export, and hotkeys.

props.name: shell
props.description: (ctx: { id, cols, rows }) => ShellSession { write, onOutput, resize?, dispose }. Defaults to the in-browser demo shell; keep the reference stable

props.name: theme
props.description: xterm theme override; defaults to the CRM tokens

props.name: onCommand
props.description: Fires for every command entered (audit logging)

usage: Hotkeys (focus inside): Ctrl+Shift+T new tab, Ctrl+Shift+W close pane, Ctrl+Shift+D / E split right / down, Ctrl+Shift+F search, Ctrl+Shift+P history palette, Ctrl+Shift+R replay, Alt+1-9 switch tab, Ctrl+Shift+[ / ] cycle. Arrow keys move between tabs, Alt+Arrow reorders, F2 renames.
